items.title: Roger Mitchell Interview, 1972-01-19
items.q: The interviewee only responds to the interviewer's description of 'Peter Clever' as a Catholic order and mentions buying a building, showing no personal connection to the person.

ctx.x: Yeah, but you haven't got the knife. That's funny. No, I got my knife and my high degree too. Can I turn on?
Is the knife of Peter Clever, is that like the masons?

Well, it's a Catholic order. Oh, a Catholic order, I didn't realize that. Yeah, it's a Catholic order. You have to be Catholic to be a knight of Peter Clever. That's the hall there on Orleans Street, between Durham and the Roman, on that side of the bank. It used to be the old French hospital.
